title: Role of SAA1 in mediating renal fibrosis through TLR4-dependent NF-kappaB activation.
authors: Wei, Xiao; Feng, Lixiang; Yuan, Yuan; Kuang, Qihui; Yu, Hong; Yang, Jun; Wang, Xiong; Luo, Pengcheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SAA1通过TLR4/NF-kB通路促进肾纤维化，虽涉及分子对接验证蛋白结合，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Renal fibrosis is a key and irreversible pathological event in the progression of chronic kidney disease (CKD), and inflammatory response plays an important role in this process. Serum amyloid A1 (SAA1), an acute-phase reactant protein, which plays an important role in inflammation as a cytokine; but its specific role in renal fibrosis remains to be studied. METHODS: In this study, SAA1 and TLR4 knockout mice were used to establish unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) animal renal fibrosis model, and HK-2 cells were used to establish TGF-beta-induced cell fibrosis model. The specific role of SAA1 in renal fibrosis was explored by immunoblotting and immunohistochemistry. Subsequently, this study used molecular docking and Co-Immunoprecipitation to verify the specific mechanism of SAA1 promoting renal fibrosis progression. RESULTS: We found that SAA1 levels were significantly increased in both in vivo and in vitro fibrosis models. Functional studies have shown that gene knockout or knockdown of SAA1 can significantly reduce the progression of renal fibrosis and limited fibrin deposition. On the contrary, overexpression of SAA1 in HK-2 cells aggravated the process of fibrosis. At the mechanism level, we found that in HK-2 cells, SAA1 can directly bind to TLR4, activate downstream NF-kappaB signaling pathway, promote the production of various cytokines, and then promote the progress of renal fibrosis. Importantly, knockdown of TLR4 alleviated this process. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates that SAA1 promotes the progression of renal fibrosis through TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景：肾纤维化是慢性肾脏病（CKD）进展中的一个关键且不可逆的病理事件，而炎症反应在此过程中发挥重要作用。血清淀粉样蛋白A1（SAA1）作为一种急性期反应蛋白，作为细胞因子在炎症中具有重要作用；但其在肾纤维化中的具体作用仍有待研究。方法：本研究利用SAA1和TLR4基因敲除小鼠建立单侧输尿管梗阻（UUO）动物肾纤维化模型，并使用HK-2细胞建立TGF-β诱导的细胞纤维化模型。通过免疫印迹和免疫组织化学方法探讨SAA1在肾纤维化中的具体作用。随后，本研究采用分子对接和免疫共沉淀验证SAA1促进肾纤维化进展的具体机制。结果：我们发现，在体内和体外纤维化模型中，SAA1水平均显著升高。功能研究表明，SAA1基因敲除或敲低可显著减轻肾纤维化的进展并限制纤维蛋白沉积。相反，在HK-2细胞中过表达SAA1则加重了纤维化过程。在机制层面，我们发现，在HK-2细胞中，SAA1可直接与TLR4结合，激活下游NF-κB信号通路，促进多种细胞因子的产生，进而促进肾纤维化的进展。重要的是，TLR4的敲低缓解了这一过程。结论：本研究证明，SAA1通过TLR4/NF-κB信号通路促进肾纤维化的进展。
